name.ja: サウザンド・サニー号 ワノ国編Ver.

categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

description.ja: 麦わら海賊団一味の装いも新たに、ワノ国編仕様のサニー号を立体化！
description.en: The Straw Hat Pirates have a new look, and the Sunny from the Wano Country edition has been made into a three-dimensional figure!

description.ja: • 全高約360mm。新規造形でワノ国編衣装の麦わら海賊団を再現。
description.en: • Overall height approximately 360mm. The Straw Hat Pirates in their Wano Country costume are recreated with new modeling.

description.ja: • ガオン砲とパドルは差し替えで再現可能。
description.en: • Gaon cannon and paddle can be reproduced by replacing them.

description.ja: • カイナスシールと水転写式デカールで、ワノ国潜入時に負ったダメージの修復後を再現できる。
description.en: • With Kynas Seal and water transfer decals, you can recreate the damage sustained when infiltrating Wano Country after it has been repaired.

description.ja: • シロモクバ１号、ミニメリー２号、シャークサブマージ３号が付属。
description.en: • Shiromokuba No. 1, Mini Merry No. 2, and Shark Submerge No. 3 are included.

description.ja: • 専用ディスプレイベース付属。
description.en: • Comes with a dedicated display base.
